**Chinese name:** 摩尔线程智能科技（北京）有限责任公司 (Mó'ěr Xiànchéng Zhìnéng Kējì (Běijīng) Yǒuxiàn Zérèn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded June 2020 by Zhang Jianzhong, Nvidia's former China general manager; filed for a mainland China IPO in late 2024 and completed it on the Shanghai STAR Market on December 5, 2025 at an issue price of ¥114.28/share — the stock later traded as high as ¥657.02 intraday. Added to the Entity List the same day as Biren (October 17, 2023), underscoring how directly the US targeted China's two leading GPU startups together. Announced in August 2026 that it was pursuing a secondary listing on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Consumer and data-center GPUs, explicitly positioned in domestic coverage as 'China's answer to Nvidia.'
